text: Title card: faint ghosted duplicate text visible behind the card (e.g. '...of strange loops' behind the 'Tangle.' wordmark, extra lines behind Begin button) and a dark rectangle at right. Looks like a second layer bleeding through.

Hall, first frame after Begin, facing the welcome plaque: a solid black rectangle (~x370-910, y45-96) sits at top-center and covers part of the NEXT objective text ('take the ... left'). Also the small right-hand 'rooms solved' sign text is very blurry ('Start with the Triangle, on the left' barely legible).

Welcome plaque: 'pt walkto plaque' parks the player 0.94m away, so the text is far too large to read without backing up. Pressing e at the plaque shows no prompt and does nothing; the objective 'Read the plaque ahead' does not tick off, so a player cannot tell whether reading 'counted'.

Triangle room at (-12.3, 3.2) facing yaw ~29: the tribar looks almost closed (ends nearly meet) yet the room is not solved; a hint caption then appears pointing to a floor ring near the entry door. No visual proximity cue (the 'rising tone' is audio only) other than a faint ring around the crosshair, so without sound the search is trial and error.

After the hint 'a ring of light has appeared on the floor, near the door you came in', walked back to the entry door of the Triangle room (-10.6, 1.8) looking down at the floor near the doorway: no ring of light is visible anywhere near the door.

Correction: the hint ring does exist, as a faint dotted circle of small dim lights beside the bench on the far wall, several metres from the entry door. It is dim and easy to miss; 'near the door you came in' oversells how close it is (it is roughly 4-5 m away and not visible when standing at the door looking around casually).

Triangle solved at (-12.2, 5.5) facing yaw ~52. Before that, standing ~0.4-0.6 m away (e.g. (-12.6, 5.2), (-11.9, 4.6)) with the tribar visibly almost closed and the crosshair on it, nothing happened for several seconds each; the acceptance zone feels tighter than the visible ring, so a player who sees it 'closed' gets no confirmation. Solve feedback itself is nice: glow, caption, NEXT updates.

Triangle debrief 'You found it.' popped up ~9 s (530 ticks) after solving while I had NOT moved. It says 'When you stepped aside, the triangle came apart' in past tense, but I never stepped aside; the NEXT line ('Walk sideways and watch it break') was cut short by the modal. The reveal the debrief describes did not happen for me.

Machine rules plaque: a block of dotted tally marks/characters from the screen behind pokes through the plaque's top-right corner (overlapping 'Turn MI into MU' title area at ~x750-845, y150-215). Plaque text itself is clear and the four rules with examples are easy to follow.

Machine room: the word screen is mounted so the rules plaque overlaps its left edge, and the button desk sits far from it: while aiming at desk buttons (looking down) the word on the screen is out of view, so after every press you must look up/turn to see the result. The prompt line (e.g. 'MIUIU -> MIUIUIUIU') helps a lot. History strip and 'N different words so far' counter are nice.

Machine room, standing at the foot of the balcony ramp at (11.2, 7.7) facing yaw ~215: the NEXT objective and caption suddenly switched to the Screen room's ('Look straight at the big screen until it shows itself many levels deep' / 'A screen that shows whatever you're looking at. Read the plaque by the door.') even though I am still in the Machine room and have not finished it (MIU not solved, balcony board unread).

Machine room, under the balcony near the far corner (x 19.5-22.7, z 5.5-7.7): the probe reports room 'scr' in parts of this area and the Machine objective ('Climb the ramp to the balcony') was replaced on the HUD by the Screen room's objective, and it did not come back after returning to room 'miu'. Also the ramp foot is hard to find: the railing is on the visible side, so from the room floor it reads as a wall.
